text: ok this is probly a silly one so apologies in advance. Im a childminder and I have a little girl staying over tonight, shes 4. She came to me with chickenpox, spots all over her tummy and back and she keeps wanting to scrach them, mum says shes had them a couple of days. Apart from the itching shes absolutley fine in herself, sat up on the sofa watching her film chatting away to me about it, totaly normal. The thing that made me panic a bit is her cheeks are bright red. BUT we were out in the garden this afternoon and it was blowing a gale and freezing, and my own two always go red faced like that after being out in wind, it's just the same as theirs and its already calming down since she warmed up inside. I think im just being extra carefull because shes not mine and I dont want to get it wrong with someone elses child. Is there anything I should be doing for the itching or anything I should watch for overnight? Sorry if this is a waste of your time
